name: Game-Theory Adversary
description: Devil's-advocate critique of a diligence record (and optionally the generated memo) through three game-theoretic lenses: signaling (Spence/Akerlof, Lo & Thakor 2022), auction (winner's-curse + 2023-cohort premium correction), Bayesian persuasion (Kamenica-Gentzkow with four empirically-documented disclosure patterns from Kao 2024, Rothenstein 2011, Yi 2024). Outputs structured findings with severity tags and a verdict on whether the adversarial pass upgrades, holds, or downgrades the recommendation.
